Files of the land prices

Source: R/land-price-get.R
land_price_files.Rd

land_price_files() lists the file of each year of land_price_get(): the nationwide file of that year's release of 地価公示 (L01) in ksjdata::ksj_available, with the columns that hold the municipality, the use, the serial number, and the price, the EPSG code of its coordinate reference system, and the number of sites. The layout of the files changes between releases, so the columns are listed for each one. It is used by the bundled pipeline.

Usage

land_price_files()

Value

A tibble with one row per year: year, file_name, the columns city_code, use_code, site_number, and price, epsg, n_points, and the url of the file.

Examples

land_price_files()
#> # A tibble: 20 × 9
#>     year file_name     city_code use_code site_number price  epsg n_points url
